{{Short description|none}} {{use dmy dates|date=October 2022}} {{Opinion polling for Brazilian presidential elections}} [[File:Brazilian DRE voting machine for 2022 elections.jpg|thumb|A Brazilian [[direct-recording electronic voting machine]]]] Since the [[2018 Brazilian general election]], polling companies have published surveys tracking voting intention for the next election. The results of these surveys are listed below in reverse chronological order and include candidates who frequently polled above 3%. The first round of the [[2022 Brazilian general election]] took place on 2 October. As no candidate reached a majority of the votes,{{cite web |title=Resultados – TSE |url=https://resultados.tse.jus.br/oficial/app/index.html#/eleicao;e=e544/resultados/cargo/1 |website=Tribunal Superior Eleitoral |access-date=3 October 2022 |archive-date=2 November 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221102121453/https://resultados.tse.jus.br/oficial/app/index.html#/eleicao;e=e544/resultados/cargo/1 |url-status=dead }} a second round was held on 30 October. ==First round==
The first round took place on 2 October 2022.{{cite web |title=Datas das eleições |url=https://www.tre-sc.jus.br/eleicoes/tire-suas-duvidas/datas-das-eleicoes |website=Tribunal Regional Eleitoral de Santa Catarina |access-date=3 October 2022 |archive-date=18 September 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220918235011/https://www.tre-sc.jus.br/eleicoes/tire-suas-duvidas/datas-das-eleicoes |url-status=dead }} === Chart === [[File:Opinion polling for the 2022 Brazilian presidential election (First round).svg|thumb|left|1000px|[[Local regression]] of polls conducted]] {{clear}}
